description: Central Station is a vibrant community shopping center strategically located in the heart of Aggieland, just a quarter mile from Texas A&M University campus in College Station, Texas. Spanning 178,141 square feet, this highly trafficked retail destination draws over 3.4 million annual visits, serving the university's 72,000+ students and 11,000+ employees alongside the surrounding residential community. The center occupies a prominent position at the intersection of Texas Avenue and Harvey Road, benefiting from exceptional visibility with over 37,000 vehicles passing daily on Texas Avenue alone. Central Station features a diverse tenant mix anchored by national retailers including HomeGoods, Spec's Wine, Spirits & Finer Foods, and Kohl's, complemented by popular dining destinations like Los Cucos Mexican Café, Napa Flats, and Chick-fil-A. The property serves a highly educated market with 49% of residents holding college degrees within 3 miles, offering everything from essential services and entertainment venues like Poet's Family Billiard Hall to specialty retailers and fast-casual dining options that cater to both the student population and established families in the Bryan-College Station metropolitan area.
